mapper.sql: id, tenant_id, conversation_id, direction, content, external_msg_id, request_id, source_context, submitted_user_id, status, error, source_inbound_turn_id, delivery_status, delivery_attempt, delivery_available_at, delivery_error, last_dispatch_at, dispatch_attempt, gmt_create

t.id, t.tenant_id, t.conversation_id, t.direction, t.content, t.external_msg_id, t.request_id, t.source_context, t.submitted_user_id, t.status, t.error, t.source_inbound_turn_id, t.delivery_status, t.delivery_attempt, t.delivery_available_at, t.delivery_error, t.last_dispatch_at, t.dispatch_attempt, t.gmt_create
mapper.select: SELECT t.id, t.tenant_id, t.conversation_id, t.direction, t.status FROM agent_conversation_turn t JOIN agent_conversation c ON c.id = t.conversation_id AND c.tenant_id = t.tenant_id WHERE t.status IN ('PROCESSING', 'QUEUED') AND t.direction = 'IN' AND t.id > #{afterId} AND c.channel = 'SQUAD_WORKFLOW' ORDER BY t.id LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO agent_conversation_turn (tenant_id, conversation_id, direction, content, external_msg_id, request_id, source_context, submitted_user_id, status, error, source_inbound_turn_id, delivery_status, delivery_attempt, delivery_available_at, delivery_error) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{conversationId}, #{direction}, #{content}, #{externalMsgId}, #{requestId}, #{sourceContext}, #{submittedUserId}, #{status}, LEFT(#{error}, 1024), #{sourceInboundTurnId}, #{deliveryStatus}, #{deliveryAttempt}, #{deliveryAvailableAt}, #{deliveryError})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM agent_conversation_turn WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND external_msg_id = #{externalMsgId} LIMIT 1
SELECT FROM agent_conversation_turn WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND conversation_id = #{conversationId} AND id = #{id} LIMIT 1
SELECT FROM agent_conversation_turn WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND conversation_id = #{conversationId} AND direction = 'IN' AND status = 'PROCESSING' ORDER BY id ASC LIMIT 1
SELECT FROM agent_conversation_turn WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND conversation_id = #{conversationId} AND direction = 'IN' AND status = 'QUEUED' ORDER BY gmt_create ASC, id ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT FROM agent_conversation_turn t JOIN agent_conversation c ON c.id = t.conversation_id AND c.tenant_id = t.tenant_id WHERE t.direction = 'IN' AND t.status = 'PROCESSING' AND c.executor_id IS NOT NULL AND (t.last_dispatch_at <= #{cutoff} OR (t.last_dispatch_at IS NULL AND t.gmt_create <= #{cutoff})) ORDER BY COALESCE(t.last_dispatch_at, t.gmt_create) ASC, t.id ASC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE agent_conversation_turn SET status = #{toStatus}, error = LEFT(#{error}, 1024), source_context = CASE WHEN source_context IS NULL THEN #{sourceContext} ELSE source_context END WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND id = #{id} AND status = #{fromStatus}
mapper.select: SELECT FROM agent_conversation_turn WHERE id = #{id} AND direction = 'OUT' LIMIT 1

SELECT id FROM agent_conversation_turn WHERE direction = 'OUT' AND delivery_status IN ('PENDING', 'SENDING') AND (delivery_available_at IS NULL OR delivery_available_at <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3)) ORDER BY id ASC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE agent_conversation_turn SET delivery_status = 'SENDING', delivery_attempt = delivery_attempt + 1, delivery_available_at = #{leaseUntil} WHERE id = #{id} AND direction = 'OUT' AND delivery_status = 'PENDING' AND (delivery_available_at IS NULL OR delivery_available_at <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3))

UPDATE agent_conversation_turn SET delivery_status = 'UNKNOWN', delivery_error = #{error} WHERE id = #{id} AND direction = 'OUT' AND delivery_status = 'SENDING' AND delivery_available_at IS NOT NULL AND delivery_available_at <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3)

UPDATE agent_conversation_turn SET delivery_status = 'CANCELED', delivery_error = #{error}, delivery_available_at = NULL WHERE id = #{id} AND direction = 'OUT' AND delivery_status IN ('PENDING', 'SENDING')
